key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9862
name: merge_pattern_words_into_grid
description: Runs several unnamed helper calls, chosen by the sign of a flag value, then, while a pending counter is positive, decrements it and ORs groups of 16-bit pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart. The same merge tail is repeated for a second set of values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:999E
name: load_coords_and_merge_grid
description: Chooses one of two sources by a zero test: a pointer-based source supplies two 32-bit values and one 16-bit value, while the other source supplies two values shifted left by 5 bits. It then calls unnamed helpers and runs the same pending-counter OR-merge into 40-byte-spaced table rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:99F0
name: load_shifted_coords_then_merge
description: Skips the helper calls when a signed flag is negative; otherwise it loads two values shifted left by 5 bits and a scaled 16-bit value, calls unnamed helpers, then runs the same counter-gated OR-merge into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B3E
name: call_four_helpers_then_merge
description: Calls four unnamed helper routines in sequence, then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart. It has no branches of its own.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B6E
name: merge_grid_after_four_helpers
description: Calls four unnamed helper routines, then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart. It is a short wrapper whose only own logic is the merge tail.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B72
name: merge_grid_after_four_helpers
description: Calls four unnamed helper routines, then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart. Its body matches its neighbour that makes the same four calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B76
name: call_four_helpers_then_merge
description: Calls four unnamed helper routines, then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart. The routine has no branch before the merge.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9BB2
name: start_blit_then_merge_grid
description: Waits on a status bit read from the DMA control register, then programs the blitter modulo, control, mask, pointer and size registers for a blit of 8 words by 248 rows and starts it. The same counter-gated OR-merge then follows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9C60
name: call_four_helpers_then_merge
description: Calls four unnamed helper routines in sequence, then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart. The routine has no branch before the merge.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9C9C
name: choose_helper_set_then_merge
description: Branches on a byte read through a pointer, calling five unnamed helpers on either path, then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9D52
name: merge_grid_after_helper_calls
description: Calls five unnamed helper routines, then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart. Its visible body is only the helper calls and the merge tail.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9D9C
name: select_record_and_copy_bytes
description: Counts down a delay, then indexes a table by a value times 50 and, if the entry is non-zero, copies a byte run from that record into a routine buffer until a zero byte, setting a length of 64. The compared values are AmigaDOS hunk type codes, so this is loader or relocation code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9DF2
name: copy_record_bytes_then_merge
description: Indexes a table of 50-byte entries and copies a zero-terminated byte run from the chosen record into a routine buffer, with a length of 64 when the entry is non-zero. It then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9E3A
name: probe_table_then_copy_bytes
description: Loops up to ten times over table entries of 86 bytes, stopping at the first one whose flag bit 1 is set, then copies a zero-terminated byte run from it into a routine buffer with a length of 32. It then runs the counter-gated OR-merge tail.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9E42
name: retry_table_probe_then_copy
description: Repeats a countdown-limited table probe of 86-byte entries until one has flag bit 1 set, then copies its byte run into a routine buffer and jumps to the counter-gated OR-merge. A failed probe falls through to clearing the pending state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9EB4
name: map_angle_to_sector_grid
description: Converts a 16-bit fraction of a full turn into degrees from 0 to 359, takes the 45-degree sector index with wrap at eight, and ORs a mask into grid entries spaced 40 bytes apart for that sector. It also copies a value into a second table and branches on whether the remainder is below 16.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9F5A
name: merge_grid_after_flag_check
description: When a pending flag is non-zero it clears it and resets a second flag, then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart, with six unnamed helper calls in the visible code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A04E
name: clear_pending_flag_then_merge
description: Stores a sentinel value into a pending state word and then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart. The visible code shows the flag clears and the merge tail only.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A100
name: clear_pending_flag_then_merge
description: Clears a pending flag and resets a second flag word, then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart. The visible code is the same flag-clear and merge tail as its neighbour.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A1E0
name: copy_state_then_merge_grid
description: Copies three pairs of 32-bit state values from one set of globals to another, compares two of them, then runs the counter-gated OR-merge of pattern words into table rows spaced 40 bytes apart.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A1E4
name: copy_state_then_call_helpers
description: Copies three pairs of 32-bit state values between globals and compares two of them, then runs the counter-gated OR-merge tail after several unnamed helper calls. It is nearly identical to its neighbour with the same state copy.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A2B6
name: set_sprite_pointers_with_control
description: Computes column offsets from horizontal positions, writes packed sprite control words into two sprite data blocks, and points the sprite pointer registers at those blocks. A branch selects between two control-word variants.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A3A2
name: setup_sprite_from_input_position
description: Takes a horizontal position from its input register, computes a column offset, writes a sprite control word and stores the sprite block pointer into a structure. It chooses between two control-word variants and picks a table entry by flag.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A46C
name: clear_two_pointer_slots
description: Sets two 32-bit pointer slots in a structure to zero and returns. It is a short leaf routine with no other logic.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A47C
name: copy_slot_when_flagged
description: When a flag value is non-zero, copies one stored 32-bit value from a structure slot into another slot, then returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A492
name: store_input_register_value
description: Copies its incoming word-sized register value into a global variable and returns. It is a one-instruction store used as a setter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A4CA
name: load_sprite_block_values
description: Copies seven 32-bit values from a structure at fixed offsets into globals and returns. The sprite registers are not written in the visible code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A50C
name: load_second_block_values
description: Copies five 32-bit values from a structure at fixed offsets into globals and returns. It is the same kind of loader as its neighbour with a different offset range.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A54E
name: set_sprite_pointers_if_idle
description: Writes sprite control words from horizontal positions and stores sprite block pointers, but only when a pending counter is zero. It otherwise follows the same column and control-word arithmetic as its neighbours.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A55A
name: load_repeated_slot_values
description: Copies one 32-bit structure value into a global variable eight times and returns. The repeated copies carry no extra logic in the visible code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A58C
name: load_tail_block_values
description: Copies seven 32-bit values from a structure at fixed offsets into globals and returns. It mirrors the other block loaders, with the offset range shifted further along the structure.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A606
name: scan_records_within_window
description: Scans a table of 86-byte entries for a flag bit, then checks up to seven non-zero 24-byte records whose scaled coordinates fall inside a window of about plus or minus 16384 around reference values. It then branches on the results and calls five unnamed helpers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A870
name: copy_palette_block_to_colors
description: Decrements a countdown and, when a table pointer is set, copies a block of palette words into the chip colour registers starting at colour register 2. It also calls two unnamed routines through pointers in the state structure.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A878
name: copy_palette_including_background
description: Decrements a countdown, then calls pointer-held routines and copies a block of palette words into the chip colour registers, including the background colour register. It has the same structure as its neighbour with a longer copy.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A912
name: project_point_if_in_range
description: Subtracts reference coordinates from a point and returns early through an unnamed helper when any component is outside plus or minus 16384. Otherwise it projects the shifted coordinates by multiplying with a stored scale value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A94A
name: evaluate_range_conditions_chain
description: Clears a flag word, then runs a long chain of sign and range comparisons on state values, calling unnamed helpers for several operands before branching to one of two paths.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:AB20
name: reset_state_to_defaults
description: Zeroes about a dozen state globals and sets defaults, including two four-character ASCII text fields. When a status bit is set it loads alternative default values and flag bytes instead.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:AC72
name: update_control_state_from_deltas
description: Derives signed deltas from two 16-bit inputs by subtracting eight and shifting, then branches through many state comparisons and flag writes while calling 17 unnamed helpers. The code references status text labels, and the routine is too large to summarise fully from the visible part.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BDCE
name: latch_two_bitfield_changes
description: Returns early when a pointer pair matches; otherwise it extracts two 2-bit fields from a flag byte and, when either differs from its last stored value, stores the new value and writes a constant of 127 to a state word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BEBE
name: wrap_angle_and_interpolate
description: Saves the current values, computes the difference from a 16-bit input, and wraps differences beyond 8192 by adding or subtracting 32768. It then interpolates between two table entries indexed by the high bits, using the low five bits as the fraction.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BEC2
name: wrap_angle_interpolate_then_call
description: Saves the current values, computes and wraps the difference from a 16-bit input, and interpolates a table value with the low five bits as the fraction. It then makes four unnamed helper calls, and it is a longer version of its neighbour.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1B0
name: interpolate_four_table_samples
description: Interpolates four values from two tables: each table is indexed by the high bits of a 16-bit input and blended with the next entry, using the low five bits as the fraction. The four blended results are kept for the caller.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1B8
name: interpolate_four_table_samples
description: Interpolates four values from two tables: each table is indexed by the high bits of a 16-bit input and blended with the next entry, using the low five bits as the fraction. The visible code has no extra branches.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1CC
name: interpolate_four_table_samples
description: Interpolates four values from two tables: each table is indexed by the high bits of a 16-bit input and blended with the next entry, using the low five bits as the fraction. It is one of several routines with this exact blend.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1E0
name: interpolate_four_table_samples
description: Interpolates four values from two tables: each table is indexed by the high bits of a 16-bit input and blended with the next entry, using the low five bits as the fraction. Its five callers reuse this blend unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1E8
name: interpolate_four_table_samples
description: Interpolates four values from two tables: each table is indexed by the high bits of a 16-bit input and blended with the next entry, using the low five bits as the fraction. The four blended results are kept for the caller.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1EC
name: interpolate_four_table_samples
description: Interpolates four values from two tables: each table is indexed by the high bits of a 16-bit input and blended with the next entry, using the low five bits as the fraction. Its body is the same as its neighbour's, with one extra store.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1F0
name: interpolate_and_blend_samples
description: Begins with the same two-table interpolation as its neighbours, then continues with further blends and a call to a one-instruction helper that merges the value 255. The visible code is long and partly truncated.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C3CE
name: transform_point_fixed_point
description: Multiplies coordinate pairs by pairs of 16-bit coefficients in fixed point, rounding up negative results, and stores the packed 16-bit outputs. It repeats for further coefficient sets and makes four unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C512
name: transform_point_fixed_point
description: Multiplies coordinate pairs by pairs of 16-bit coefficients in fixed point, rounding up negative results, and stores the packed 16-bit outputs. The routine makes four unnamed calls and has no branches beyond the rounding.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C656
name: transform_point_fixed_point
description: Multiplies coordinate values by 16-bit coefficients in fixed point, rounding up negative results, and stores packed 16-bit outputs. It makes six unnamed calls and writes several output words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C79A
name: divide_by_shift_subtract
description: Negates a negative input, then runs an eight-step shift-and-subtract loop, a bit-serial division pattern, and returns the packed result pair. The visible code shows no other side effects.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C7C4
name: compute_signed_remainder
description: Returns zero when the divisor is zero, otherwise works on absolute values of two 16-bit operands, takes a remainder and restores the sign of the dividend. A divisor of -32768 is handled as a special case.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C820
name: subtract_helper_from_constant
description: Calls an unnamed helper and returns the constant 16384 minus its result. It is a five-instruction wrapper.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C82C
name: search_sorted_table_index
description: Takes the absolute value of a signed 16-bit input, scans a sorted table for the first entry greater than it, and returns that index shifted left by five bits, negated when the input was negative.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C862
name: check_status_conditions_with_labels
description: Checks flag and range conditions on state values and calls seven unnamed helpers along the chosen branch. The routine references three status text labels: ready for takeoff, safe landing and weapons replenished.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D0CE
name: map_angle_sector_then_merge
description: Sets a bit in a flag byte, converts a 16-bit fraction of a turn into degrees, derives a 45-degree sector with wrap at eight, and copies grid values spaced 40 bytes apart before ORing merged words into the grid. Six unnamed helpers are called.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D0F2
name: run_status_display_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs a blit of 4 words by 256 rows, then branches over state copies and calls 12 unnamed helpers. The routine references weapon and target status labels, and its visible code is long and partly truncated.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D82A
name: clear_region_with_blit
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, sets its modulo and control registers to a destination-only blit with no logic function, and starts a blit of 4 words by 256 rows, which writes zeros to the region.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DA0E
name: copy_region_with_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then starts a copy from the source channel to the destination channel with a 32-byte modulo and a blit of 4 words by 256 rows. It returns a value combined from the input register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DA2C
name: interpolate_then_start_blit
description: Advances a 32-bit accumulator; when its high bit is clear it waits for the blitter and starts a 4-word by 256-row copy blit. Otherwise it interpolates two table values from a rotated index and calls 16 unnamed helpers, referencing fragments of text labels.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DEF2
name: shift_source_words_into_rows
description: Checks two inputs against fixed bounds, and when both fall inside them loops six times over five source words, shifting each by a variable bit count and storing merged words into the destination rows. Otherwise it returns without writing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DFB0
name: compute_scaled_offset_difference
description: Returns the difference of two products, each scaled by a value shifted by a variable amount from coordinate differences, plus a constant of 146.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E00C
name: start_masked_copy_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, sets its modulo and pointer registers from a state base plus an offset, selects a copy function with full masks, and starts a blit of 4 words by 256 rows. It returns its input byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E068
name: clear_offset_region_with_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, sets the destination pointer from a state base plus an offset, and starts a destination-only blit of 4 words by 256 rows that clears the region.
